thread:
carol: FYI we just saw a brief blip where the console showed multiple connections for the same client_id. stack trace in logs: ```INFO sse: accept connection tenant=zoomy client_id=svc:ab12 route=eu1 session_token=tok_XYZ action=attach_or_new```
nikhil: was that the mid-morning deploy? any billing impact?
carol: deploy was earlier. billing pipeline shows normal token accounting (no duplicate bill records), but per-route active_sessions jumped to 2 for ~90s for some tenants.
rebecca: sounds like a resume vs new-session ambiguity. do we set a new session_id on resume today?
carol: we sometimes allocate a fresh session when the proxy returns 204 or early EOF during resume handshake. the client reconnects with a resume token but routing fallback can land them on a different shard that doesn't accept the token, so we create a fresh session. telemetry currently only records the session_id and route, not whether resume was attempted/failed.
theo: we need a short-term fix for the console so it doesn't surface this as "duplicate connections" and alarm on it. Proposal: emit a low-cardinality metric sse.session_start{outcome:resume|new|fallback}.
nikhil: +1 on the metric. keep tags minimal: outcome and route_region. avoid tagging tenant on the metric to control cardinality. use per-tenant aggregate counters separately.
rebecca: for the UI: show a small orange "resumed" pill next to the connection when the client presented a resume token within X seconds of the prior session. add a hover text: "Client reattached using resume token; routing fallback created a new backend session — billing unaffected."
carol: UX is fine but we need to avoid mis-labeling multiple true concurrent clients behind same nat as resumes. add heuristic: only mark as resumed if resume_token present AND previous session last_seen < 15s.
theo: also, instrumentation: emit a sampling trace when we create a fresh session despite resume token with fields: route_shard, prev_session_shard, client_ip, token_present. keep sampling rate 1%.
infra-bot: incident alert: streaming-duplicate-connections triggered 2026-03-23T10:12:05Z on route eu1 (suppressed)
nikhil: rollout plan: 1) instrument metric and a boolean trace, 2) console badge behind FF, 3) canary telemetry for 5% tenants, 4) enable UI FF for internal tenants, 5) expand to all. monitor false_positive_rate (FP = badge marked but client_ip differs).
rebecca: cardinality consideration: Avoid adding outcome to high-cardinality metrics. We'll add outcome only to derived rollups exported to Prometheus (resume_rate per route_region). Raw logs will still have token info for SLO investigations.
carol: short-term live patch: console alert rule should ignore duplicate session spikes if they correlate with resume_rate > 0.5 within 1m window. Can we do that quickly?
theo: yes I can tweak alert rule in OpsConfig. I'll add clause: unless label resume_ratio>0.5.
ikhil: add a runbook step: if you see duplicate sessions and resume_ratio low, escalate to runtime and check shard affinity changes in the last hour.
rebecca: PRs: telem PR (sse/telemetry/resume-outcome), console PR (ui/conn-badge/resume-pill), alert PR (ops/alerts/sse-dup-exemption). I'll link them to PLAT-9002.
console-bot: created ticket PLAT-9002 "SSE resume instrumentation + UI badge" assigned to carol, nikhil, rebecca, theo
carol: small snippet for telemetry (pseudo): ```metrics.counter('sse.session_start', 1, tags={'outcome': outcome, 'route_region': region}) logs.emit('sse.resume_attempt', {'tenant': t, 'token': bool(token), 'prev_session': prev_sid})```
theo: note: logs.emit will go to hot path. keep payload tiny. avoid serializing full headers.
nikhil: let's schedule canary tomorrow 08:30 UTC for telemetry only, UI behind FF next week. rebecca can you draft the tooltip copy and make sure product sign-off?
rebecca: will do, pinging @product for copy review in PLAT-9002. ETA EOD.
carol: anything else? we should also keep an eye on resume token expiry edgecases — if token expired clients will reauthenticate and create new sessions which is normal. runbook note: confirm token validity window before classifying as resume failure.
rebecca: added runbook line: "check token ttl and previous session last_seen". also added a diagnostic query to correlate client_ip and token hash.
nikhil: thanks team. action items recap: carol -> coordinate PLAT-9002, theo -> alert rule change + sampling trace, rebecca -> UI badge + tooltip, nikhil -> canary cadence + runbook update.
console-bot: auto-note: please update PLAT-9002 with canary results. :white_check_mark:
